headline: Eaton Canyon Serenity Pavilion
articleBody:
1,200 sq ft glass-walled pavilion with geothermal lap pool, living water wall, and Japanese maple grove. Passive climate control maintains 72°F year-round. Rooftop solar powers all automation systems.

Outcome: 12-week delivery. 42% energy independence. Featured in Metropolis magazine. Private meditation retreats $45K/year.
